digo_source: Mgombato ('mrenda ... jute, bush okra (Corchorus olitorius)'); Pakia Appendix III ('Phombo' = C. olitorius; Pakia gives 'Mrenda' for Sesamum calycinum)
english: Jute mallow, Jew's mallow, bush okra

teaser.en: These leaves turn slippery in the pot, and that is exactly what makes them a well-loved relish with ugali.
teaser.sw: Majani haya huteleza yanapopikwa chunguni, na hilo ndilo hasa linalofanya yawe mboga inayopendwa sana ya kulia ugali.
teaser.dg: Makodza higa ganakala ga luhe nyunguni, na ndiyo sababu ni mboga inayomendzwa sana, inayoriwa na sima.

summary.en: *Mrenda*, also *mwatsaka wa bara*, is jute mallow, an upright herb grown in farms and gardens in the rains. Its leaves cook down into a slimy relish eaten with ugali.
summary.sw: *Mrenda*, pia *mwatsaka wa bara*, ni mrenda, mmea mdogo uliosimama unaolimwa mashambani na bustanini wakati wa mvua. Majani yake hupikwa kuwa mboga inayoteleza inayoliwa kwa ugali.
summary.dg: *Mrenda*, piya *mwatsaka wa bara* (kpwa Chingereza *jute mallow*), ni mmea uimao chocho unaorimwa minda na busitani wakati wa mvula. Makodzage nkujitwa gakakala mboga ya luhe inayoriwa na sima.

about.en: *Mrenda* is an upright, branching herb with oval leaves that have finely toothed edges, often with two thin bristles at the base. Small yellow flowers sit where the leaves join the stem, and they are followed by long, narrow, ridged seed pods. When the leaves are cooked they turn slimy, which is the whole point.
about.sw: *Mrenda* ni mmea mdogo uliosimama wenye matawi, wenye majani yenye umbo la yai yenye meno madogo pembeni, mara nyingi yakiwa na vinyweleo viwili vyembamba kama singa kwenye kitako. Maua madogo ya manjano huota mahali majani yanapoungana na shina, na hufuatwa na maganda marefu, membamba, yenye mistari iliyoinuka. Majani yakipikwa huteleza, na hiyo ndiyo hasa sababu ya kuyapika.
about.dg: *Mrenda* ni mmea uimao chocho wenye panda nyinji, na makodza ganayohalana na tumbi kpwa sura, genye meno madide sana kanda-kanda, na mara nyinji gana nyere mbiri nyembamba photsi ya kodza. Maruwa madide ga rangi ya mandano ganakala phatu makodza ganaphogbwirana na mlita, na bada yao kunatuluka makakaya marefu, membamba, genye mistari. Makodza gachijitwa ganakala ga luhe, na hicho ndicho chinachohendzwa.

where.en: It is grown on farms and in gardens during the rains, when the young plants are picked for their leaves.
where.sw: Hulimwa mashambani na bustanini wakati wa mvua, ambapo mimea michanga huchumwa kwa ajili ya majani yake.
where.dg: Nkurimwa minda na busitani wakati wa mvula, wakati mitse nkungobolwa kpwa sababu ya makodzage.

uses.en: The leaves are cooked into a slimy vegetable relish eaten with ugali.
uses.sw: Majani hupikwa kuwa mboga inayoteleza inayoliwa kwa ugali.
uses.dg: Makodza nkujitwa gakakala mboga ya luhe inayoriwa na sima.

names.en: Mgombato gives two Digo names for jute mallow: *mrenda* and *mwatsaka wa bara*. Pakia calls it *phombo* and uses *mrenda* for a different plant, a wild sesame that is also cooked as a slimy vegetable. Swahili calls jute mallow *mrenda* or *mlenda*, and Mgombato also gives *kala*. In English it is jute mallow, Jew's mallow or bush okra. Note that on its own, *mwatsaka* is the Digo word for the chilli pepper plant.
names.sw: Mgombato inatoa majina mawili ya Kidigo ya mrenda: *mrenda* na *mwatsaka wa bara*. Pakia anauita *phombo* na anatumia *mrenda* kwa mmea mwingine, ufuta pori ambao pia hupikwa kama mboga inayoteleza. Kwa Kiswahili mrenda huitwa *mrenda* au *mlenda*, na Mgombato pia inatoa *kala*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *jute mallow*, *Jew's mallow* au *bush okra*. Kumbuka kwamba likiwa peke yake, *mwatsaka* ni neno la Kidigo la mmea wa pilipili.
names.dg: Mgombato anapha madzina mairi ga Chidigo ga *jute mallow*: *mrenda* na *mwatsaka wa bara*. Pakia anauiha *phombo*, na anahumira *mrenda* kpwa mmea wanjina, ufuha wa weruni (*wild sesame*), ambao piya nkujitwa ukakala mboga ya luhe. Chiswahili chinauiha *mrenda* au *mlenda*, na Mgombato anapha piya *kala*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *jute mallow*, *Jew's mallow* au *bush okra*. Manya kukala *mwatsaka* macheye ni dzina ra Chidigo ra mmea wa pilipili (*chilli pepper*).

reason.en: Wild sesame, which Pakia also calls mrenda
reason.sw: Ufuta pori, ambao Pakia pia anauita mrenda
reason.dg: Ufuha wa weruni, ambao Pakia piya anauiha *mrenda*.

reason.en: Another vegetable that turns slimy when cooked
reason.dg: Mboga yanjina inayokala ya luhe ichijitwa.

reason.en: The chilli pepper, which shares part of its name
reason.sw: Pilipili, inayoshiriki sehemu ya jina lake
reason.dg: Mwatsaka, ambao dzinare ni seemu ya dzina ra mmea huno.

reason.en: Another leafy green eaten with ugali
reason.sw: Mboga nyingine ya majani inayoliwa kwa ugali
reason.dg: Mboga yanjina ya makodza inayoriwa na sima.

mgombato: mrenda (mi) type of plant: jute, bush okra, Jew's mallow (Corchorus olitorius); mrenda, kala. (See: mwatsaka wa bara)
mwatsaka wa bara (mi) jute, bush okra, Jew's mallow; mrenda, kala. (See: mrenda)
